title: $6.3 Billion Gone in 20 Minutes 🚨 #shorts
description:
Binance says about $6.3 billion was taken from its hot wallets on 29 October 2026 - the biggest crypto theft ever reported. Nearly $3 billion has been frozen. About $3.3 billion is still missing.
Blockchain firm TRM Labs linked the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor group; no government has confirmed this.
Full story coming on the channel - follow for part 2.
